title: Agentic Model Checking
abstract: arXiv:2605.21434v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Verifying large software systems is difficult. Formal specifications are rarely available, and the assumptions that code relies on are often encoded implicitly at call sites rather than enforced at function boundaries. This paper presents agentic model checking, a verification scheme that combines LLM agents with bounded model checking (BMC) under the principle that agents propose, solvers verify: agents perform semantic reasoning such as specification inference and verification planning, while the formal backend checks the resulting bounded verification queries. We realize this scheme in BMC-Agent, an agentic verification system built on an off-the-shelf bounded model checker.   The key contribution of this paper is agentic orchestration of the model checker. translated_abstract: 验证大型软件系统十分困难。形式化规范通常难以获得，而且代码所依赖的假设往往在调用处以隐式方式编码，而非在函数边界强制执行。本文提出了智能体化模型检查，这是一种将大语言模型智能体与有界模型检测相结合的验证方案，其核心原则是“智能体提出，求解器验证”：智能体负责规范推断和验证规划等语义推理工作，而形式化后端则对生成的有界验证查询进行检验。我们在 BMC-Agent 中实现了这一方案，该系统构建在一个现成的有界模型检测器之上。本文的关键贡献在于对模型检测器的智能体化编排。BMC-Agent 并非采用固定的单一验证流程，而是为每个验证任务规划如何应用有界模型检测。它能够推断函数规范，并据此构建……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出智能体化模型检测及其实例 BMC-Agent，遵循“智能体提出、求解器验证”的原则，让 LLM 智能体负责规范推断与验证规划等语义推理，由有界模型检测器进行形式化验证，从而实现对大型软件系统的自动验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces agentic model checking, realized in BMC-Agent, which orchestrates bounded model checking with LLM agents under the principle "agents propose, solvers verify," where agents handle specification inference and verification planning while the formal backend verifies the resulting bounded queries.
